equal_partible_inheritance.name: Equal Inheritance
equal_partible_inheritance.observation: Under the civil code every child inherits an equal share, and peasant families have fewer children to keep the holding whole.
equal_partible_inheritance.social_consequence: Holdings are split smaller each generation; parents limit births to spare the land.

vaccination_mortality_tables.name: Vaccination Tables
vaccination_mortality_tables.observation: The death tables show smallpox falling wherever vaccination is taken up, and doubters are answered with figures.

soldier_family_allowances.name: Separation Allowances
soldier_family_allowances.observation: The families of serving soldiers draw a separation allowance while the man is away.

war_dependants_pensions.name: War Pensions
war_dependants_pensions.observation: Widows and orphans of the fallen draw a pension from the treasury.
war_dependants_pensions.social_consequence: A pensions office now keeps the rolls of the war dead's families.

assisted_emigration.name: Assisted Emigration
assisted_emigration.observation: The parish or the state pays the passage of paupers to new lands overseas.
assisted_emigration.social_consequence: Emptying the poor-house by ship is called charity by some and banishment by others.

age_specific_fertility_rates.name: Age Fertility Rates
age_specific_fertility_rates.observation: Births and marriages are reckoned for each age of women, and fertility can be compared across districts.

mortality_table_insurance.name: Life Insurance Tables
mortality_table_insurance.observation: Life insurance is priced from observed death tables, and a clerk can buy security for his widow.

state_statistical_office.name: Statistical Office
state_statistical_office.observation: A state office publishes tables of population, births, deaths and trade every year.
state_statistical_office.social_consequence: A chief statistician now reports to the ministers.

colony_land_sale_scheme.name: Colony Land Scheme
colony_land_sale_scheme.observation: Colony lands are sold in lots, and the money pays passage for young couples to farm them.

cause_of_death_tables.name: Cause-of-death Tables
cause_of_death_tables.observation: Registered deaths are tabulated by cause, age and district, and the killing streets stand out in the tables.

household_schedule_census.name: Household Census
household_schedule_census.observation: Every household fills a schedule of each member's name, age, trade and birthplace on one night.
household_schedule_census.ability_reason: The state knows who lives where and what they do, household by household.
household_schedule_census.social_consequence: Enumerators knock on every door; many fear the schedule is a tax or a draft in disguise.

national_life_tables.name: Life Tables
national_life_tables.observation: Life tables for the whole realm show how long people of each age can expect to live.

working_mothers_creches.name: Crèches
working_mothers_creches.observation: Mill towns open crèches where working mothers leave their infants by day.

emigrant_passenger_law.name: Passenger Law
emigrant_passenger_law.observation: Emigrant ships are inspected for space, food and water, and captains are fined for overcrowding.

steamship_mass_emigration.name: Mass Emigration
steamship_mass_emigration.observation: Steamships carry emigrants by the hundred thousand to distant lands in a fortnight.
steamship_mass_emigration.ability_reason: Crowded districts can shed their surplus people, and remittances flow home.
steamship_mass_emigration.social_consequence: Whole villages empty of their young; letters and money come back, and so does news of better wages.

district_mortality_comparison.name: District Mortality
district_mortality_comparison.observation: Death rates are compared by district and by trade, and the deadliest occupations are named.

childrens_hospitals.name: Children's Hospitals
childrens_hospitals.observation: Hospitals are built for sick children, with nurses and physicians who treat only the young.

inter_realm_statistical_congress.name: Statistical Congress
inter_realm_statistical_congress.observation: Statisticians from many realms agree how people are to be counted and classed.

rubber_sheaths.name: Rubber Sheaths
rubber_sheaths.observation: Rubber sheaths for men are sold openly by chemists and barbers.
rubber_sheaths.social_consequence: Preachers denounce them, and their sale is prosecuted in some towns.

civil_marriage_registrar.name: Civil Marriage
civil_marriage_registrar.observation: Couples may marry before a registrar, with no shrine and no priest.
civil_marriage_registrar.social_consequence: The shrines lose their hold on marriage records; many still marry twice.

orphan_boarding_out.name: Boarding Out
orphan_boarding_out.observation: Orphans are boarded with foster families in the country instead of barrack asylums.

homestead_land_grants.name: Homestead Grants
homestead_land_grants.observation: Free land is granted to settler families who live on it and farm it for five years.
homestead_land_grants.ability_reason: Families can found farms on open land, and the frontier fills.
homestead_land_grants.social_consequence: The land is taken from those who hunted and grazed it before; settler and native meet in bloodshed.

manufactured_infant_food.name: Bottle Feeding
manufactured_infant_food.observation: Tinned infant food and feeding bottles let mothers wean early and return to work.
manufactured_infant_food.social_consequence: Bottle-fed babies die of summer diarrhoea; weaning early shortens the gap to the next birth.

residence_naturalisation.name: Naturalisation
residence_naturalisation.observation: Foreigners may become citizens after years of residence.

family_limitation.name: Family Limitation
family_limitation.observation: Couples of every class plan fewer children, spacing births and stopping early by withdrawal and abstinence.
family_limitation.ability_reason: Fertility falls on its own, and each child gets more of the household's care and food.
family_limitation.social_consequence: Families of two or three become the rule; the old call it selfish, preachers call it sin.

population_pyramid_charts.name: Population Pyramids
population_pyramid_charts.observation: Age and sex of the whole population are charted as a pyramid, showing the wars and famines as notches.

premature_infant_incubator.name: Incubators
premature_infant_incubator.observation: Premature infants are kept warm in heated glass boxes, and many survive who would have died.

antiseptic_maternity_wards.name: Antiseptic Maternity
antiseptic_maternity_wards.observation: Maternity wards use antiseptic washing and clean linen, and deaths of mothers in childbed fall sharply.

sutured_surgical_birth.name: Sutured Surgical Birth
sutured_surgical_birth.observation: The surgeon sutures the womb after cutting the child out, and mother and child both live.

raised_consent_age.name: Consent Age Law
raised_consent_age.observation: The age of consent and the lowest age of marriage are raised by law.

settlement_houses.name: Settlement Houses
settlement_houses.observation: Educated young people live in settlement houses in the slums and run clubs and classes.

household_poverty_surveys.name: Poverty Surveys
household_poverty_surveys.observation: Investigators walk every street and class households by their poverty.

room_overcrowding_census.name: Room Census
room_overcrowding_census.observation: The census counts rooms and persons per room, and overcrowding becomes a measured evil.

immigration_inspection_station.name: Immigration Station
immigration_inspection_station.observation: Arrivals are examined for health and papers at an island station before they may enter.
immigration_inspection_station.social_consequence: The sick and the suspect are sent back across the ocean.

infant_milk_depots.name: Milk Depots
infant_milk_depots.observation: Depots give out clean bottled milk for infants, weigh the babies and advise their mothers.

child_growth_records.observation: Each child's weight and height are charted against age standards, and a faltering child is noticed early.
child_growth_records.ability_reason: A child who is failing to thrive is caught while there is still time.

infant_mortality_index.name: Infant Mortality Index
infant_mortality_index.observation: The infant death rate is published town by town as the measure of each town's health.

registered_midwives.name: Registered Midwives
registered_midwives.observation: Midwives must be trained, examined and registered, and untrained women may not attend births for pay.

newborn_health_visitors.name: Health Visitors
newborn_health_visitors.observation: A health visitor calls on every newborn's household within days of the birth.

child_protection_law.name: Child Protection
child_protection_law.observation: Officers may remove neglected and beaten children from their homes.

antenatal_clinics.name: Antenatal Clinics
antenatal_clinics.observation: Mothers are examined in clinics before the birth, and dangerous pregnancies are caught early.

maternity_benefit.name: Maternity Benefit
maternity_benefit.observation: Sickness insurance pays a benefit to mothers for weeks around the birth.

childrens_welfare_bureau.name: Children's Bureau
childrens_welfare_bureau.observation: A children's bureau studies why infants die and advises every town.

birth_control_clinics.name: Birth-control Clinics
birth_control_clinics.observation: Clinics fit married women with caps and give advice on spacing children.
birth_control_clinics.ability_reason: Women can choose when to bear children, not only whether to marry.
birth_control_clinics.social_consequence: The clinics are raided and their founders jailed before the law gives way.

origin_immigration_quotas.name: Immigration Quotas
origin_immigration_quotas.observation: Immigrants are admitted by quota according to their land of origin.
origin_immigration_quotas.social_consequence: Families are split at the border by the quota line.

treaty_population_exchange.name: Population Exchange
treaty_population_exchange.observation: After a war two realms exchange their minorities by treaty, and a million are uprooted.
treaty_population_exchange.social_consequence: Refugees arrive destitute; the lost homes are mourned for generations.

widows_orphans_insurance.name: Widows' Pensions
widows_orphans_insurance.observation: Contributory insurance pays pensions to widows and orphans.

court_adoption_orders.name: Adoption Orders
court_adoption_orders.observation: Adoption becomes a court order, and the child's old records are sealed.

demographic_transition_theory.name: Transition Theory
demographic_transition_theory.observation: Demographers describe how death rates fall first and birth rates follow.

maternal_death_inquiries.name: Maternal Death Inquiries
maternal_death_inquiries.observation: Every death of a mother in childbirth is investigated, and the avoidable cause is named.

pronatalist_bonuses.name: Pronatalist Bonuses
pronatalist_bonuses.observation: Couples receive bonuses and marriage loans forgiven with each child.
pronatalist_bonuses.social_consequence: Women are pressed back into the home; births rise briefly and fall again.

obstetric_flying_squads.name: Obstetric Squads
obstetric_flying_squads.observation: A squad with blood, drugs and a surgeon drives out to home births that go wrong.

child_evacuation_schemes.name: Child Evacuation
child_evacuation_schemes.observation: Children are sent by train from bombed towns to strangers in the country.
child_evacuation_schemes.social_consequence: Children are parted from parents for years; some never return home.

cohort_population_projection.name: Cohort Projections
cohort_population_projection.observation: Future population is projected age group by age group from births, deaths and migration.

displaced_persons_camps.name: Displaced Camps
displaced_persons_camps.observation: After a world war millions live in camps and wait to be sent home or resettled.

universal_family_allowances.name: Family Allowances
universal_family_allowances.observation: The state pays a weekly allowance for every child in every family.
universal_family_allowances.ability_reason: No child goes without because the family is large.
universal_family_allowances.social_consequence: A family allowance office pays every mother; employers argue it holds down wages.

birth_cohort_study.name: Birth Cohort Study
birth_cohort_study.observation: Every child born in one week is followed from birth through life.

refugee_convention.name: Refugee Convention
refugee_convention.observation: A treaty defines who is a refugee and forbids sending them back into danger.
refugee_convention.ability_reason: Those fleeing persecution have a legal claim to shelter abroad.
refugee_convention.social_consequence: Every realm now keeps an asylum office, and the numbers of claimants are a matter of fierce debate.

hospital_birth_norm.name: Hospital Births
hospital_birth_norm.observation: Nearly every birth takes place in hospital, with a surgeon and blood close by.

guest_worker_programmes.name: Guest Workers
guest_worker_programmes.observation: Foreign workers are recruited on fixed contracts to fill the factories.
guest_worker_programmes.social_consequence: The guests stay and send for families; the hosts never expected them to.

household_residence_permits.name: Residence Permits
household_residence_permits.observation: Every family is bound by permit to its town or village, and moving without leave is forbidden.
household_residence_permits.social_consequence: Country people become second-class; millions live in towns without papers.

oral_contraceptive_pill.name: Contraceptive Pill
oral_contraceptive_pill.observation: A daily hormone pill prevents pregnancy, controlled by the woman herself.
oral_contraceptive_pill.ability_reason: Women decide the number and timing of their children with near certainty.
oral_contraceptive_pill.social_consequence: Marriage, schooling and work for women change within a generation; the shrines condemn the pill.

retirement_communities.name: Retirement Villages
retirement_communities.observation: Retirement villages and pensions give a long old age outside work.

newborn_blood_screening.name: Newborn Screening
newborn_blood_screening.observation: A spot of blood from every newborn's heel is tested for inherited disease.

family_planning_fieldwork.name: Family-planning Fieldwork
family_planning_fieldwork.observation: Field workers carry coils and pills to villages and teach couples to space their children.

neonatal_intensive_care.name: Neonatal Intensive Care
neonatal_intensive_care.observation: Newborn intensive care nurseries keep tiny premature infants breathing and warm.

rh_disease_prevention.name: Rh Prevention
rh_disease_prevention.observation: An antibody injection protects the next child of an Rh-negative mother.

points_based_immigration.name: Points Immigration
points_based_immigration.observation: Immigrants are admitted by points for skills and language.

continuous_population_register.name: Population Register
continuous_population_register.observation: Every person carries an identity number on one register from birth to death.

small_family_campaigns.name: Small-family Campaigns
small_family_campaigns.observation: Posters and broadcasts urge two children as the right number for a family.

no_fault_divorce.name: No-fault Divorce
no_fault_divorce.observation: Couples may divorce without proving fault.

equal_birth_status.name: Equal Birth Status
equal_birth_status.observation: Children born outside marriage gain equal rights with those born within it.

prenatal_ultrasound.name: Prenatal Ultrasound
prenatal_ultrasound.observation: Sound-wave scans follow the unborn child and show twins, breech and troubles early.

legal_pregnancy_termination.name: Legal Termination
legal_pregnancy_termination.observation: Pregnancy may be ended safely in licensed clinics, and back-street deaths stop.
legal_pregnancy_termination.social_consequence: The question divides the people bitterly for decades.

inter_realm_population_conference.name: Population Conference
inter_realm_population_conference.observation: Realms meet on population and development and agree to put women's health and choice first.

paid_parental_leave.name: Parental Leave
paid_parental_leave.observation: Mothers and fathers take paid leave after a birth.

in_vitro_fertilisation.name: Test-tube Conception
in_vitro_fertilisation.observation: An egg is fertilised in a dish and returned to the womb, and a child is born.
in_vitro_fertilisation.ability_reason: Couples who could not conceive can have children.
in_vitro_fertilisation.social_consequence: Shrines and courts argue over who may use it and what becomes of spare embryos.

skin_to_skin_newborn_care.name: Skin-to-skin Care
skin_to_skin_newborn_care.observation: Small newborns are carried against the mother's skin, keeping them warm and fed without an incubator.

state_birth_quotas.name: Birth Quotas
state_birth_quotas.observation: The state fixes how many children each couple may have, and officials enforce the quota.
state_birth_quotas.social_consequence: Forced procedures, missing daughters and a generation of only children; resentment and a lopsided population last for decades.

register_based_census.name: Register Census
register_based_census.observation: The census is drawn from registers without enumerators going door to door.

fertility_sample_surveys.name: Fertility Surveys
fertility_sample_surveys.observation: Sample surveys across many realms measure fertility, contraception and child health.

long_acting_contraception.name: Long-acting Contraception
long_acting_contraception.observation: Hormone implants and injections prevent pregnancy for months or years.

surrogacy_contracts.name: Surrogacy Contracts
surrogacy_contracts.observation: Surrogate births are regulated by contract and law.

registered_partnerships.name: Registered Partnerships
registered_partnerships.observation: Unmarried couples may register a partnership with rights close to marriage.

preimplantation_testing.name: Embryo Testing
preimplantation_testing.observation: Embryos are tested for inherited disease before one is placed in the womb.

sex_selection_ban.name: Sex-selection Ban
sex_selection_ban.observation: Scanning to learn the sex of the unborn in order to choose is banned.

long_term_care_insurance.name: Long-term Care Insurance
long_term_care_insurance.observation: Insurance pays for the care of the frail old at home or in care homes.
long_term_care_insurance.ability_reason: The long old age that medicine has won is cared for without ruining the family.
long_term_care_insurance.social_consequence: A care ministry and a vast care workforce appear; the young pay more for the old each year.

emergency_contraception.name: Emergency Contraception
emergency_contraception.observation: A pill taken after intercourse prevents pregnancy and is sold over the counter.

dual_citizenship.name: Dual Citizenship
dual_citizenship.observation: Citizens may hold the citizenship of another realm as well.

dementia_care_units.name: Dementia Care
dementia_care_units.observation: Memory clinics and dementia units care for the old who lose their minds.

mobile_remittances.name: Mobile Remittances
mobile_remittances.observation: Migrants send wages home by mobile phone in minutes.

indexed_pension_age.name: Indexed Pension Age
indexed_pension_age.observation: The pension age rises with life expectancy.

egg_freezing.name: Egg Freezing
egg_freezing.observation: Women freeze their eggs and delay childbearing into their late thirties.

mobile_birth_registration.name: Mobile Birth Registration
mobile_birth_registration.observation: Births in remote districts are registered by mobile phone.

genetic_ancestry_testing.name: Ancestry Testing
genetic_ancestry_testing.observation: Ancestry is read from a swab of the cheek.

excess_death_tracking.name: Excess-death Tracking
excess_death_tracking.observation: Weekly excess deaths are tracked in a pandemic to see its true toll.

remote_worker_visas.name: Remote-worker Visas
remote_worker_visas.observation: Visas let remote workers live in one realm and work for another.

low_fertility_family_package.name: Family Package
low_fertility_family_package.observation: Guaranteed childcare places and baby bonuses try to halt the fall in births.

climate_managed_resettlement.name: Managed Resettlement
climate_managed_resettlement.observation: Districts lost to rising seas and heat are resettled by plan before the disaster strikes.
climate_managed_resettlement.ability_reason: Whole districts move before the sea takes them, rather than fleeing after.
climate_managed_resettlement.social_consequence: Old homes and graves are abandoned; the resettled grieve and quarrel over compensation.

artificial_womb_support.name: Womb Support
artificial_womb_support.observation: Extremely premature infants are supported in fluid-filled womb systems.
